title: Redundancy, Resilience & Path Geometry — Cord, Width, Straightness and Healing
purpose: Turn biblical/project imagery of threefold cords, straight/level paths, burdens and broad/narrow ways into a disciplined resilience/accessibility model while keeping theology separate from engineering claims.
epistemic_rule: Ecclesiastes, Proverbs, Psalms, Isaiah, Matthew and Hebrews are not engineering manuals. Graph connectivity, reliability, tortuosity and capacity are modern comparators used to sharpen the project vocabulary.

resilience_layer.edge_connectivity: lambda(s,t)=minimum number of edges whose removal disconnects s from t; in the finite-graph Menger setting this equals the maximum number of pairwise edge-disjoint s-t paths
resilience_layer.node_connectivity: kappa(s,t)=minimum internal vertices whose removal disconnects s from t, matched to internally vertex-disjoint paths under the corresponding Menger formulation
resilience_layer.project_relation: A cord/bundle is strongest as a resilience symbol when support strands are genuinely independent enough that one failure does not disable all function.
resilience_layer.common_mode_warning: Three nominal strands can still fail together if all depend on the same hidden node, power source, legal permission, institution or correlated hazard.
resilience_layer.capacity_warning: Disjoint routes may exist but have insufficient capacity; path count alone is not service resilience.

simple_reliability_comparator.independent_parallel_links: If independent links each fail with probability p_i, probability all parallel links fail is product_i p_i; independence is a strong assumption.
simple_reliability_comparator.identical_case: for n independent equal-failure links, P(all fail)=p^n
simple_reliability_comparator.warning: Do not apply this formula when failures are correlated or links share dependencies.

path_geometry_layer.endpoint_distance: d_geo(x0,x1)=geodesic distance in the declared geometry
path_geometry_layer.tortuosity: tau=L(gamma)/d_geo(x0,x1)>=1 when endpoints differ and the metric/geodesic are well-defined
path_geometry_layer.interpretation: Higher tortuosity means a longer or more circuitous route relative to the geodesic baseline; it is not morally worse by itself.
path_geometry_layer.straight_path_caution: Biblical straight/level path language is ethical/poetic and should not be reduced to minimum Euclidean length.

path_accessibility_layer.state: traveler has capability vector c and path/environment has demand vector q(s)
path_accessibility_layer.feasible_traversal: a path is accessible when required demands remain within the traveler's supported capability envelope after available assistance/adaptation
path_accessibility_layer.project_relation: Hebrews 12:13's straight/level-path-to-healing cluster encourages a relational model: improve the route/environment rather than treating all failure as a defect in the traveler.
path_accessibility_layer.boundary: This is a structural comparison, not a medical treatment claim.

width_capacity_layer.corridor_width: w(s) can constrain passage/capacity in a spatial model
width_capacity_layer.reachable_volume: broader feasible corridors may enlarge reachable states in some systems
width_capacity_layer.nonmonotone_value: More width/capacity can be helpful, neutral or harmful depending on destination, flow, safety and objective.
width_capacity_layer.biblical_control: Matthew 7 assigns negative valence to the broad destructive way; Psalm 118 assigns positive valence to release into a broad/spacious place. Geometry does not settle value.

burden_layer.weight_effect: Higher running cost can make an otherwise reachable path impractical; removing burden can change optimal or viable routes without altering topology.
burden_layer.boundary: Sin, guilt and moral burden are theological/ethical concepts, not literal mechanical mass.

path_preparation_metrics.maximum_gradient: max |dz/ds| in a spatial path where slope matters
path_preparation_metrics.minimum_clearance: minimum distance to obstacles in declared configuration space
path_preparation_metrics.control_effort: minimum or expected input cost to keep trajectory within safe corridor
path_preparation_metrics.robust_margin: distance to constraint violation under allowed disturbance set
path_preparation_metrics.project_value: These metrics make 'make the path straight/level' testable in real engineered or institutional systems instead of using straightness as a decorative moral word.

test_cards.question: Do apparent multiple support paths actually survive single-point and common-mode failures?
test_cards.negative_result: Paths collapse to one hidden bottleneck; threefold appearance is not real redundancy.

test_cards.question: Does route redesign increase successful traversal for constrained/vulnerable agents?
test_cards.negative_result: Straightening/leveling does not improve traversal or creates new failure modes.

test_cards.question: Does increasing feasible width/capacity improve the declared objective?
test_cards.negative_result: Greater width increases harmful flow, decreases guidance or does not improve the target outcome.
